takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, tender, proud] Mom already set the place. [softly firm] She set it at every dinner for fifty years. [warm, certain] There is always one more seat.

takes.line: d|amy|My stopwatch. It is still running. It is at nine hundred and eleven hours, and some seconds.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, stunned, quiet] My stopwatch. It is still running. [proud, amused] It is at nine hundred and eleven hours, and some seconds.

takes.line: d|amy|Three thousand miles. One ride. Mom, Dad, you can come to Tom’s any Tuesday you like.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, awed, brisk] Three thousand miles. One ride. [teasing, tender] Mom, Dad, you can come to Tom's any Tuesday you like.

takes.line: d|deedee|Boppy fell asleep in the recliner somewhere over Nebraska. He says it is the best nap of his life. He says his back has never felt worse.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [amused, chatty] Boppy fell asleep in the recliner somewhere over Nebraska. [wry, fond] He says it is the best nap of his life. [dry, giggly] He says his back has never felt worse.

takes.line: d|amy|Justin is coming out on the next one. He booked his own ticket. He says he cleared the whole weekend. I have been looking at the calendar for an hour to make sure it is real.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [heavy Long Island accent, giddy, disbelieving] Justin is coming out on the next one. [stunned, soft] He booked his own ticket. He says he cleared the whole weekend. [sheepish, bright] I have been looking at the calendar for an hour to make sure it is real.
